topup_order_not_found: No top-up order has this trade number. Check the number and try again.

topup_method_unsupported: Only Stripe top-up orders can be completed manually.

topup_search_keyword_invalid: A search needs at least 2 characters other than %, _ and !. Enter a longer order number.

no_billing_customer: This project has no billing profile yet. It's created with the first payment.
wallet_ledger_range_invalid: This date range can't be shown. Choose a range of at most 32 days.

payment_document_reconcile_failed: The invoice and receipt could not be reconciled with Stripe. Try again later.

referral_code_reserved: That name isn't available. Try another.

promotion_config_invalid: Check the promotion percentages, caps and time windows.
referral_status_invalid: This referral status filter is invalid.
